Method of Attack: Exploits vulnerable GIGABYTE driver to elevate privileges and install malicious unsigned Windows drivers
Terminates antivirus and security software processes to disable protection

Circumvents anti-ransomware defenses by killing antivirus software before deploying ransomware executable
Impacted Systems: Windows 10 PCs with vulnerable GIGABYTE drivers
Attack Vector: Vulnerable GIGABYTE driver exploited to load unsigned drivers
Indicators of Compromise: Killed antivirus and security software processes
